scientific_integrity: All-time identities are proven; numerical tests corroborate only selected parameter cases. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Balanced positive payoff matrices and predator-persistence \(Kr\delta>1\); deterministic positive initial conditions. Not robust to arbitrary payoff perturbations. Global phase relation follows from exact structural cancellation, not general three-dimensional predator-prey dynamics.
title: Exact eco-evolutionary selection and neutral-memory foliation under constant aggregate payoffs
